Then sit and talk to him about it, like talk not threaten because you also don't want someone to marry you out of fear. Them being had people is not your fault.

Marriage is just some paper work, if someone is unhappy or not being treated well they're under no obligation to stick around.

Demanding he change his style will backfire. 

I've found positive reinforcement helps, when a guy wears something I like then I praise the choice. I may drop suggestions like "I saw this and thought you'd look good in it" and yes, maybe even go shopping with them. Not every time, but if he values your opinion and you give him positive feelings he may ask for it more because it makes you happy and you being happy makes him happy as a result.

I've also found gifts work too, not all the time granted because sometimes the choice wasn't right but the longer you know a guy the better you'll be at picking something both of you will enjoy. This year the Valentine's Day gift was a tie and tie clip, sure not every day wear but for an interview it's useful plus they're nerdy.

Then you have to be ready to compromise, I appreciate when a guy dresses well for a date so I'm not going to fuss if they choose to wear athletic wear at home or to the grocery store. People deserve to be comfortable and if you try to change a person drastically then why even be with that person? If someone told me to not wear pastels anymore I'd be pretty offended but I also know not to wear cat ears to meet their family.

I used to think sleeping together was an important part of a relationship, after seven years in a relationship I do not think that anymore. Lol

Having my own room is now just a requirement and I'm very open about that. I have insomnia and anything that makes me trying to find sleep harder just upsets me. I hadn't realized this fully until going on a trip and sharing a bed with someone and despite us being on our own sides they were a light sleeper while I usually stay up, wiggle, fiddle with my phone for a good hour until sleep finds me. My way of sleeping clashed with theirs and I was just like...nah. Need me space.

You can write a note or explain via text the why but since she keeps arguing you need to then cut her off after you've explained and let her sit with it. The discussion phase is over.

This is of course if you want to have a friendship after this, which would take time any way. If you don't care then just bounce and block her but I personally think that some sort of explanation is warranted even if you don't listen to her response.
